headline_en: Chennai data centre: L&T begins construction on 52MW AI facility
headline_hi: चेन्नई डेटा सेंटर: लार्सन एंड टुब्रो ने 52MW की एआई सुविधा पर निर्माण शुरू किया
summary: On 28 October, vyoma.AI plans to construct over 250 MW of data centre capacity throughout India.

headline_en: Squad update: India adds Auqib Nabi for first three New Zealand ODIs
headline_hi: टीम अपडेट: भारत ने पहले तीन न्यू जीलैंड वनडे के लिए आकिब नबी को जोड़ा
summary: Fast bowler Pacer Pacer Auqib Nabi joined India's team on 31 October for the initial three one-day internationals facing New Zealand.

headline_en: Thousands rally in Manipur to demand abrogation of Suspension of Operations agreement
headline_hi: मणिपुर में सस्पेंशन ऑफ ऑपरेशंस समझौते को रद्द करने की मांग को लेकर हजारों लोगों ने रैली निकाली।
summary: On Friday evening, thousands of people in five Manipur valley districts staged a sound protest. Protesters in Imphal marched towards the Kangla heritage complex.

headline_en: Hylo Open: PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen advance to tournament finals
headline_hi: हइलो ओपन: पीवी सिंधु और लक्ष्य सेन टूर्नामेंट के फाइनल में पहुंचे
summary: On Saturday 31 October 2026, PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen reached the final of the Hylo Open in Saarbrucken, Germany.

headline_en: Quad foreign ministers launch Indo-Pacific maritime surveillance and energy security plans
headline_hi: क्वाड के विदेश मंत्रियों ने हिंद-प्रशांत मैरीटाइम सर्विलांस और एनर्जी सिक्योरिटी प्लान लॉन्च किए।
summary: On 31 October, "I was pleased to meet with my Quad counterparts in Atlanta and discuss the real progress we have made in turning our shared priorities into real benefits for US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said.

headline_en: Andhra Pradesh CM seeks central funds as Cyclone Arnab leaves seven dead
headline_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश सीएम ने केंद्र से फंड मांगा क्योंकि साइक्लोन अर्नब के कारण सात लोगों की मौत हो गई
summary: On Thursday, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu conducted an aerial survey of cyclone-affected areas and toured Cyclone Arnab-hit areas in Konaseema. On Saturday, two Inter-Ministerial Central teams inspected cyclone Arnab-hit areas along the Godavari river in East Godavari district and coastal pockets of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district.

headline_en: Odisha flood rescue: Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari deploys 313 teams
headline_hi: ओडिशा बाढ़ बचाव: आपदा प्रबंधन मंत्री सुरेश पुजारी ने 313 टीमें तैनात कीं
summary: On 29 October, 313 teams were engaged in rescue operations, including 9 NDRF, 60 ODRAF, and 244 fire department teams, Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said.

headline_en: Bengaluru FC substitute Vinith Venkatesh: late equalising goal against NorthEast United FC
headline_hi: बेंगलुरु एफसी के सब्स्टीट्यूट विनीत वेंकटेश: नार्थईस्ट संयुक्त एफसी के खिलाफ अंतिम समय में बराबरी का गोल
summary: Bengaluru FC substitute Vinith Venkatesh netted a late equalising goal against NorthEast United FC during Friday's Indian Super League fixture at the Indira Gandhi Stadium.

headline_en: Millions of valid voters names incorrectly added in Maharashtra, Haryana, and Karnataka
headline_hi: महाराष्ट्र, हरियाणा और कर्नाटक में लाखों वैध मतदाताओं के नाम गलत तरीके से हटाए गए
summary: On 31 October, the India Block held a mock parliament to conduct a symbolic public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

headline_en: IPO debt repayment: Jio Platforms allocates $2.89 billion to clear borrowings
headline_hi: आईपीओ ऋण भुगतान: जियो प्लेटफॉर्म्स ने उधार चुकाने के लिए 2.89 अरब डॉलर आवंटित किए
summary: Jio Platforms raised $3.2bn in its stock market debut. Reliance Jio Platforms soared 27% in its Mumbai debut on Wednesday.

headline_en: Hylo Open semifinal: P V Sindhu credits husband for courtside support
headline_hi: हइलो ओपन सेमीफाइनल: पी वी सिंधु ने कोर्ट के किनारे समर्थन के लिए पति को श्रेय दिया
summary: On Friday, P V Sindhu secured a 21-12, 21-10 victory in the quarterfinal against Germany's compatriot Amalie Schulz Anmol Kharb.

headline_en: PM Modi hails ISRO for NVS-03 launch strengthening India's NavIC system
headline_hi: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी ने नाविक प्रणाली को मजबूत करने के लिए एनवीएस-03 के प्रक्षेपण पर इसरो की सराहना की
summary: On 31 October, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, "Congratulations to our scientists and engineers at ISRO on the successful launch of GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03."

headline_en: Two foreign nationals die of electrocution in Bengaluru hotel pool
headline_hi: बेंगलुरु के एक होटल के पूल में करंट लगने से दो विदेशी नागरिकों की मौत हो गई
summary: Two foreign nationals died due to electrocution in the swimming pool of the Conrad Hotel in Bengaluru on Friday evening around 5:30 PM.

headline_en: Indian bowler Arshdeep Singh claims 150th T20I wicket in 103 matches
headline_hi: भारतीय गेंदबाज अर्शदीप सिंह ने 103 मैचों में 150वां टी20 अंतरराष्ट्रीय विकेट हासिल किया
summary: On Friday, Nitish Kumar Reddy caught the ball hit by Mitchell Santner near the boundary. Arshdeep Singh is the third fastest bowler to reach 150 T20I wickets in terms of matches played.

headline_en: New artificial lake forms at Taktsemakhang following Shintapu Tsho glacial flood
headline_hi: शिन्तापू त्शो हिमनद बाढ़ के बाद ताक्तसेमाखांग में नई कृत्रिम झील बनी
summary: A glacial lake outburst flood occurred in Shintapu Tsho in the Laya area of Gasa district on Thursday night, 29 October 2026.

headline_en: Enforcement Directorate detains Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan outside Rampur Jail
headline_hi: एनफोर्समेंट डायरेक्टरेट ने रामपुर जेल के बाहर समाजवादी पार्टी के नेता आज़म खान को हिरासत में लिया
summary: On Saturday evening, the Enforcement Directorate team took Mohammad Azam Khan into custody.

headline_en: Job verification order: Lucknow mandates multi-state police checks for new recruits
headline_hi: नौकरी सत्यापन आदेश: लखनऊ ने नए रंगरूटों के लिए बहु-राज्य पुलिस जांच अनिवार्य की
summary: On 28 October, Principal Secretary M Devraj issued a 21-page order regarding guidelines for character and background verification of candidates before appointment to government jobs. In special cases, investigation on the spot can be conducted on the instructions of the appointing authority.

headline_en: Ramlila Maidan rally: INDIA bloc protests against election chief Gyanesh Kumar
headline_hi: रामलीला मैदान रैली: इंडिया गठबंधन ने चुनाव आयोग के प्रमुख ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ विरोध प्रदर्शन किया
summary: The India Gathbandhan organized a mega rally at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

headline_en: Joshimath crash: rescue teams recover all six bodies after weekend operation
headline_hi: जोशीमठ क्रैश: सप्ताहांत के ऑपरेशन के बाद बचाव दलों ने सभी छह शव बरामद किए
summary: The recovery operation was halted on Friday due to darkness, wild animals, and difficult terrain.

headline_en: Delhi enforces 50 percent work from home and vehicle ban
headline_hi: दिल्ली 50 प्रतिशत वर्क फ्रॉम होम और वाहन प्रतिबंध लागू करती है
summary: On 31 October, Chief Minister Rekha Gupta appealed to people, vehicle owners, construction agencies, and business locations to follow the rules.

headline_en: Cyclone Murasu: storm to cross Andhra coast with 120 kmph winds
headline_hi: साइक्लोन मुरासु: 120 किमी प्रति घंटे की हवाओं के साथ आंध्र तट को पार करेगा तूफान
summary: On 28 October, severe cyclonic storm Arnab hit Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. It is expected to intensify further into a severe cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal by 2 November

headline_en: Opposition rally: BJP labels INDIA bloc leaders as thugs in poster
headline_hi: विपक्ष की रैली: भाजपा ने पोस्टर में इंडिया अलायंस के नेताओं को थग्स बताया
summary: Today, the Bharatiya Janata Party released a poster titled 'Thago Ka Mela' (Fair of Thugs), targeting Congress leader.

headline_en: Quad foreign ministers announce 85 million dollars for artificial intelligence in Indo-Pacific
headline_hi: क्वाड विदेश मंत्रियों ने हिंद-प्रशांत में कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के लिए 85 मिलियन डॉलर की घोषणा की
summary: On Saturday, Quad foreign ministers announced plans to provide more than $85 million in assistance to expand access to trusted Super Intelligence.

headline_en: LPG price hike: commercial cylinder rates rise by 10 rupees across India
headline_hi: एलपीजी मूल्य वृद्धि: पूरे भारत में कमर्शियल सिलेंडर की दरों में 10 रुपये की बढ़ोतरी हुई।
summary: The price (Gas Price News Commercial LPG Cylinder Price) of a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder in Delhi increased by ₹10 to ₹2,820.

headline_en: Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu discuss military options against Iran by phone
headline_hi: डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने फोन पर ईरान के खिलाफ सैन्य विकल्पों पर चर्चा की
summary: US President Donald Trump spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu by telephone on Saturday.
